body: Classification complete: the remainder is NOT one specificity shape. I recorded the full partition on the bead. Short version: uniform is an unconditional leaf proportion with only a zero-leaf absence defect; importance has weight-sum value conditioning but separate leaf-availability coverage and needs a ruling; six external terms plus distorted are unconditional mean-per-unit row masses (and rows may be subnormalized, so swapping count for summed mass changes the estimand); distortedByFacet conflates no rows with true zero through an empty map; perUnitLocalizability needs per-unit typed absence. The migration-status doc is also materially stale against current source. I made no edit or reservation and will stay sequenced for D2.
